notices.short_title: FY27 City Council / Court-Involved Youth Mental Health Initiative / HIV/AIDS Pathways 27AS024001R0X00
notices.description:
This is a notice that DOHMH is seeking comments from the public about the proposed contract below.
   
Contract Type: New Contract  
Contractor: The Osborne Association, Inc
Contractor Address: 809 Westchester Avenue, Bronx, NY 10455
Scope of Services: This funding is to supports HIV/AIDS prevention, education, outreach, advocacy, and support services. Organizations under this initiative focus on identifying diagnosed and undiagnosed HIV-positive individuals linking them to care and medication, including PrEP and PEP Services. The initiative aims to reach vulnerable and at-risk populations, including communities of color, seniors, and individuals with mental health and/or substance use disorders. The funding also supports programs that utilize risk assessment tools to identify juveniles in the arrest process who require mental health services and that provide family counseling. 
Maximum Value: $1,051,527.00
Term: 7/1/2026 through 6/30/2029
Renewal: N/A
